title: Differentially Private Conditional Independence Testing
role: prior methodological counterevidence; rules out broad novelty claim for private dependence testing
sections_checked: two private CI procedures (generalized covariance and conditional randomization test)
evidence_note: Provides private conditional-independence procedures with guarantees, including a model-X conditional randomization test. It predates the sampled dHSIC work but does not address the exact same joint-independence statistic or directed local-DP attribute leakage.

title: Correlated Data in Differential Privacy: Definition and Analysis
role: prior survey counterevidence; rules out claim correlated-data DP is unexplored
evidence_note: Surveys parameter-, model-, and Pufferfish-based treatments of correlated-data privacy. Broad correlated-data privacy questions are longstanding; it does not independently validate the specific 2025 CPL metric or its four-dataset conclusions.

title: Practical and Accurate Local Edge Differentially Private Graph Algorithms
role: adjacent privacy-model counterevidence; clarifies incompatible protection units
sections_checked: edge adjacency definition and local edge-DP guarantee
evidence_note: Demonstrates graph-structure-dependent utility for edge-level local DP, but edge adjacency does not equal user-level or attribute-level privacy. Preserve these threat-model boundaries when synthesizing CPL or adaptive composition evidence.
